name: Manual, Exploratory & Functional Testing
description: Hands-on functional testing, test case authoring, comprehensive defect lifecycle management, exploratory testing execution, cross-browser validation, and user acceptance testing.

subskills.name: Structured Test Case Authoring
subskills.description: Writing structured test cases with clear preconditions, unambiguous steps, test data, and precise expected results.

subskills.name: Defect Reporting & Bug Lifecycle
subskills.description: Writing detailed defect reports (steps to reproduce, environment, logs, severity vs priority, expected vs actual).

subskills.name: Smoke & Sanity Testing
subskills.description: Build acceptance testing, fast sanity verification of core functionality after deployments and hotfixes.

subskills.name: Regression Testing & Impact Analysis
subskills.description: Impact analysis, regression test suite maintenance, selecting test subsets for release candidate builds.

subskills.name: Exploratory & Ad-hoc Testing
subskills.description: Unscripted bug hunting, edge-case probing, tour-based exploratory testing, persona-based scenarios.

subskills.name: Cross-Browser & Device Compatibility
subskills.description: Cross-browser matrix testing (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and cross-OS rendering checks.

subskills.name: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & Sign-Off
subskills.description: Facilitating UAT with business stakeholders, alpha/beta testing coordination, production readiness sign-off.

subskills.name: Localization (L10n) & i18n Testing
subskills.description: L10n/i18n testing, RTL languages, character encodings (UTF-8), date/time format verifications.

subskills.name: Usability & Heuristic Evaluation
subskills.description: Nielsen’s usability heuristics, UX anomaly identification, accessibility workflow evaluation.

github.signal: Test case spreadsheets, markdown matrices, or defect templates in repository
Regression test checklists or cross-browser compatibility matrices
UAT sign-off documentation or localization/usability test logs

cv.signal: Manual testing, test case authoring, bug reporting, or smoke testing described
Regression testing, exploratory testing, UAT, or cross-browser testing leadership

linkedin.signal: Manual Testing, Bug Tracking, or Test Case Execution endorsed
Regression Testing, Exploratory Testing, or UAT mentioned

junior.description: Writes clear, reproducible test cases, logs comprehensive bug reports with logs, and executes smoke/sanity testing.

mid.description: Maintains regression suites through impact analysis, uncovers edge cases with exploratory testing, and validates cross-browser matrices.

senior.description: Coordinates UAT with business stakeholders, leads L10n/i18n validation across multiple locales, and conducts usability heuristic audits.
